name: restored-game-sync
symptoms: Minimap clicks did not appear to move the world view.
GPU camera movement did not move the minimap view rectangle.
Unit movement changed vision state but did not repaint newly visible terrain until later camera movement.
Native UI clicks were intermittently delayed or appeared lost.

findings.native_input: aui_SDLMouse::GetInput returned after one motion event, allowing motion backlog to starve later button-down/up transitions.
findings.synthetic_native_handoff: SetSyntheticInput permanently made aui_SDLMouse::GetInput reject real motion and button events after automated game setup; wheel input bypassed that guard and remained functional.
findings.minimap: Whole-map GPU pan changes camera offset without changing TiledMap::m_mapViewRect; RadarMap drew only the raw engine rectangle.
findings.vision: Vision mutations updated resources through sprite submission, but no deferred TiledMap::Refresh rebuilt the whole-map terrain texture; the terrain stayed black until camera movement.
